sn35.120:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Sāriputto Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
sn35.120:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn35.120:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam etad avoca || ||
sn35.120:1.4: Saddhivihāriko āvuso Sāriputta bhikkhu sikkham paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto ti || || 4
sn35.120:2.1: Evam etam āvuso hoti indriyesu aguttadvārassa bhojane amattaññūno jāgariyam ananuyuttassa ||
sn35.120:2.2: so vatāvuso bhikkhu indriyesu aguttadvāro bhojane amattaññu jāgariyam ananuyutto yāvajīvam paripuṇṇam parisuddham brahmacariyaṃ santānessātīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || || 5
sn35.120:2.3: So vatāvuso bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū jāgariyam anuyutto yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇam parisuddham brahmacariyam santānessatīti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati || 6
sn35.120:3.2: Idhāvuso bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī || yatodhikaraṇam
sn35.120:3.3: enam cakkhundriyam asaṃvutaṃ viharantam abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāsaveyyuṃ || tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati || rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaram āpajjati || ||
sn35.120:3.8: Manasā dhammam viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī || yatodhikaraṇam
sn35.120:3.9: enam manindriyam asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāsaveyyuṃ || tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati || rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaram āpajjati || ||
sn35.120:3.10: Evaṃ kho āvuso indriyesu guttadvāro hoti || || 7
sn35.120:4.3: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvad eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsuparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya iti purāṇañca vedanam paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā ti || ||
sn35.120:4.4: Evam kho āvuso bhojane mattaññū hoti || || 8
sn35.120:5.2: Idhāvuso bhikkhu divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittam parisodheti ||
sn35.120:5.3: rattiyā pathamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇūyehi dhammehi cittam parisodheti ||
sn35.120:5.4: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pāde pādam accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññam manasikaritvā ||
sn35.120:5.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmam paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittam parisodheti || ||
sn35.120:5.6: Evam kho āvuso jāgariyam anuyutto hoti || || 9
sn35.120:5.8: Indriyesu guttadvārā bhavissāma bhojane mattaññuno jāgariyam anuyuttā ti || || Evam
